work.code:
# Draft: tests for discount codes at checkout. Not run or reviewed.
# Placeholders: checkout.pricing, Cart, DiscountError, apply_discount and the codes
# SAVE10 (ten percent off), SUMMER (expired) and TENOFF (fixed amount off) must be
# matched to the real code and test data.
from datetime import date
import pytest
from checkout.pricing import Cart, DiscountError, apply_discount
def make_cart(total_cents):
    return Cart(items=[{"sku": "ITEM", "price_cents": total_cents, "qty": 1}])
def test_percent_code_reduces_total():
    cart = apply_discount(make_cart(10000), "SAVE10", today=date(2026, 1, 15))
    assert cart.total_cents == 9000
def test_percent_code_rounds_half_up_to_whole_cents():
    # Expected rule, to confirm: round half a cent up. 995 less ten percent is 895.5.
    cart = apply_discount(make_cart(995), "SAVE10", today=date(2026, 1, 15))
    assert cart.total_cents == 896
def test_expired_code_is_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(DiscountError):
        apply_discount(make_cart(10000), "SUMMER", today=date(2026, 10, 1))
def test_fixed_code_never_makes_total_negative():
    cart = apply_discount(make_cart(500), "TENOFF", today=date(2026, 1, 15))
    assert cart.total_cents == 0
def test_same_code_cannot_apply_twice():
    cart = apply_discount(make_cart(10000), "SAVE10", today=date(2026, 1, 15))
    with pytest.raises(DiscountError):
        apply_discount(cart, "SAVE10", today=date(2026, 1, 15))
